audience.text: Python developers building 3D content pipelines, especially in 3D printing, CAD, and visualization workflows requiring format conversion and scene graph manipulation.

capabilities.text: Import OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, and 3MF files using Scene.open() with automatic format detection from file extension or explicit FileFormat.
capabilities.title: Load multiple 3D formats

capabilities.text: Write scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF, and 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific options for compression, coordinate flipping, and unit scaling.
capabilities.title: Export to common 3D formats

capabilities.text: Build meshes from control points and polygons, convert primitives to meshes, and modify geometry using Mesh.control_points and Mesh.create_polygon.
capabilities.title: Construct and manipulate meshes

capabilities.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure diffuse, specular, emissive, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.
capabilities.title: Assign materials to geometry

capabilities.text: Organize entities using Node.create_child_node(), Node.add_entity(), and Node.child_nodes, with independent Transform per node for translation, rotation, and scale.
capabilities.title: Build and traverse scene graphs

capabilities.text: Convert arbitrary polygon data into triangle fans using PolygonModifier.triangulate(), a real ear-clipping triangulation implementation.
capabilities.title: Triangulate arbitrary polygons

capabilities.text: Build animation clips with AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence, and store skeletal bind-pose data with Pose and related types.
capabilities.title: Create keyframe animations

limitations.text: COLLADA export is not reachable through Scene.save() because IOService's exporter lookup fails before reaching ColladaExporter.
FBX export raises NotImplementedError outright; FBX import is experimental with only tokenizer-level tests and no real .fbx fixtures verified.
Scene.render() and the entire aspose.threed.render module raise NotImplementedError; this library does not render scenes to images.
Texture and TextureBase raise NotImplementedError on construction; image-backed textures cannot be created, though material properties work independently.
Mesh boolean operations (do_boolean, union, difference, intersect) raise NotImplementedError; CSG operations are not implemented.
NURBS curve and surface evaluation (NurbsCurve.evaluate, NurbsSurface.to_mesh) raise NotImplementedError; NURBS can be configured but not sampled.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation, modification, and export of 3D scenes using a pure-Python API without requiring external SDKs or native binaries.
Supports interoperability across common 3D formats (OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, 3MF) through a unified Scene/Node/Mesh object model.
Provides parameterized primitives (Box, Sphere, Cylinder, etc.) and direct mesh construction via control points and polygons for custom geometry.
Supports material assignment (Lambert, Phong, PBR) and keyframe animation for realistic rendering preparation and skeletal animation data.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for loading, constructing, and exporting 3D scenes without native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported for import beyond OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, and 3MF is not fully specified beyond the listed limitations.
Whether FBX import works reliably with real-world files is uncertain due to lack of integration tests with actual .fbx fixtures.
The behavior of Scene.save() when no format can be inferred from filename or explicit FileFormat is not documented in the facts.

workflows.name: Import and inspect 3D scenes
workflows.text: Load OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, or 3MF files using Scene.open() and inspect geometry, nodes, and materials.

workflows.name: Build scenes from scratch
workflows.text: Construct meshes via control points and polygons, attach primitives, assign materials, and organize nodes in a scene graph.

workflows.name: Export to target formats
workflows.text: Write scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF, or 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific SaveOptions for compression, coordinate flipping, and unit scaling.

workflows.name: Triangulate polygon meshes
workflows.text: Convert arbitrary polygon data into triangle fans using PolygonModifier.triangulate() for compatibility with formats requiring triangular faces.

workflows.name: Construct keyframe animations
workflows.text: Build animation clips with AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence for skeletal and transform-based animation data.
